purpose: Test whether explicit same-view ORION image evidence repairs v10's view-selection and multi-view-support failures without changing Stage-1 U or assigning task relevance to the adapter.

architecture.additional_visual_evidence: six canonical frozen ORION image-backbone grids pooled to 10x10
architecture.binding: each R query receives only its matching [view,y,x] feature before global VLM fusion
architecture.warm_start: failed v10 Phase-A LoRA, spatial query base, and relevance head; new evidence projection is randomly initialized

early_stop.rule: After a milestone, stop when dev AP drops while train AP rises by the frozen minimum deltas; also stop immediately on full Phase-A gate pass.

release_gates.interpretation: Unchanged v10 engineering Phase-A gates; passing does not unlock any later stage.

additional_diagnostics: threshold-free AP and foreground prevalence by split and event
spatial probability/target tensors at every 40-step milestone
train/dev AP trend for explicit overfit stopping
claim_boundary: Bounded 17-event Phase-A engineering repair only. A pass is learnability evidence, not formal generalization, planning, closed-loop, or safety evidence.
